name: GET /api/leadflow/identity/links/:merge_id/blast-radius - what a retraction would touch, before it is committed
description:
The confirmation step behind AC1: what undoing this link would reach, shown BEFORE anything is undone.

SHOWN FIRST BECAUSE A RETRACTION IS NOT SMALL. Reversing a link republishes every projection built on it, and an operator deserves to know that a one-click reversal reaches conversations and consent receipts before they click it, not afterwards in an incident review.

EVERY CATEGORY IT CANNOT COUNT IS NAMED, AND `affected` IS EMPTY RATHER THAN FULL OF ZEROS. The first draft of this counted local leads against the merge's two person ids. It could not: `leads` carries no person id of any kind and a merge names two UPSTREAM person ids, so the query had nothing to join on and would have answered 0 - 'no leads affected' - for a question it never actually asked. A fabricated zero on a confirmation dialog is worse than an absent number, because the operator reads it as a checked fact and clicks through on the strength of it. Campaign enrollments, conversations and consent receipts live in sdk-campaign, sdk-conversation and sdk-consent respectively and cannot be enumerated from here either, so each is listed with the reason it is unknown.

LEADS BECOME COUNTABLE the day a lead records the canonical person it resolved to. Until then the honest answer is that we do not know, which is why the category is listed rather than dropped - an omitted category reads as zero.

THE REVERSIBILITY SENTENCE IS PART OF THE ANSWER, not decoration. Retracting emits a compensating event and deletes nothing - neither the original merge nor either source record - but the projection replay that follows cannot be selectively undone, and a screen that says 'reversible' without that qualifier is overpromising to somebody about to act on it.

requiresRole:["data_steward"] and NO testCase pins an Authorization header (MUST-71). QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: The blast radius names every category it cannot count instead of reporting zeros

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the header is absent or not Bearer. Not authored as a testCase: pinning it would defeat the role swap (MUST-71).

errorCases.message: No policy grants this action to the caller's roles.
errorCases.when: the caller does not hold identity.merge_review. Not reachable while this definition runs under requiresRole.
